items.docs: Returns the per-account feature-flag entitlements for the authenticated business. The desktop (dripos) client treats every flag as a grant that fails closed: any flag not returned with `enabled: true` is denied client-side. Entitlements are resolved server-side from a per-account allowlist keyed on the business's unique email. Requires a secret key (`sk_*`); public keys (`pk_*`) receive `403 Forbidden`.
